NoteGenie review: an AI note taker for busy teams

By Dana Lee

NoteGenie joins your video calls, records the conversation and writes a summary when the meeting ends. We used it for two weeks across sixteen meetings.

What it does

The app transcribes speech in real time and highlights action items. Summaries arrive in your inbox about two minutes after a call.

  • Live transcription in 12 languages
  • Automatic action items with owners
  • Search across every past meeting

Limitations

Speaker labels were wrong when two people talked at once. The free plan keeps only the last 30 days of recordings.

Share Tweet

Verdict: a solid choice for teams that live in meetings, as long as you check the speaker names.
